sourceChecks.text: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の系譜・文脈で照合し、このcontextでの指示対象を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites. These are the families of the Kohathites.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の系譜・文脈で照合し、このcontextでの指示対象を確認。

sourceChecks.text: According to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の氏族奉仕記述で確認。

sourceChecks.text: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の系譜・文脈で照合し、このcontextでの指示対象を確認。

sourceChecks.text: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の氏族奉仕記述で確認。

sourceChecks.text: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, the screen, and all its service.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の氏族奉仕記述で確認。

sourceChecks.text: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の系譜・文脈で照合し、このcontextでの指示対象を確認。

sourceChecks.text: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の氏族奉仕記述で確認。

sourceChecks.text: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の系譜・文脈で照合し、このcontextでの指示対象を確認。

sourceChecks.text: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の系譜・文脈で照合し、このcontextでの指示対象を確認。

sourceChecks.text: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の氏族奉仕記述で確認。

sourceChecks.text: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の氏族奉仕記述で確認。

sourceChecks.text: “Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の氏族奉仕記述で確認。

sourceChecks.text: but do this to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint everyone to his service and to his burden;
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の氏族奉仕記述で確認。

sourceChecks.text: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の氏族奉仕記述で確認。

sourceChecks.text: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の氏族奉仕記述で確認。

sourceChecks.text: Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の氏族奉仕記述で確認。

sourceChecks.text: These are those who were counted of the families of the Kohathites, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の氏族奉仕記述で確認。

sourceChecks.text: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them; they carried it on their shoulders.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の系譜・文脈で照合し、このcontextでの指示対象を確認。

sourceChecks.text: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の氏族奉仕記述で確認。

sourceChecks.text: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を該当節と前後の系譜・文脈で照合し、このcontextでの指示対象を確認。
